主要内容: On March 28, 2017, Optical Cable Corporation shareholders approved the 2017 Stock Incentive Plan, which permits restricted stock, stock awards, and performance-based compensation. The plan allows performance-based awards to qualify for tax deductions under Section 162(m) of the Internal Revenue Code. It became effective on March 28, 2017 and will terminate on February 26, 2027. The plan includes 536,903 shares for issuance, with caps of 250,000 shares and $2,000,000 in cash per participant annually. The Compensation Committee administers the plan and has discretion over award types and terms. The plan aligns with SEC Rule 16b-3 and Section 409A of the Code for deferred compensation. It is subject to adjustments for corporate events such as stock dividends, splits, or mergers. The plan provides a framework for incentive compensation structures within the company's financial services sector.
